leastWorthwhile.text: Setting Theia on a collision course was straightforward and the only available action, though its explanation of impact geometry was useful.

surprise.text: I was interested that some simulations form a large satellite more directly, rather than through the disk-accretion route shown here.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt clearly arbitrary; the available choices had understandable physical purposes, though the menu supplied their compatibility.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the orbiting debris becomes the Moon; this chapter leaves that process open.
